title: Iron Man
postCreditDetails: Nick Fury visits Tony Stark at his Malibu mansion, introducing himself as director of S.H.I.E.L.D. and bringing up the Avengers Initiative.
summary: Genius weapons manufacturer Tony Stark experiences a profound moral reckoning after being ambushed and captured in Afghanistan by the terrorist faction Ten Rings. Constructing a rudimentary powered exoskeleton with captured parts alongside scientist Yinsen, Stark breaks free from captivity. Upon returning home, he renounces weapons manufacturing and perfects an advanced red-and-gold armored suit. When mentor Obadiah Stane betrays him to seize the technology, Tony must publicly embrace his heroic armor and challenge Stane in an explosive duel across Los Angeles.
spoilerSummary: Stane steals the miniaturized arc reactor directly from Tony's chest to power his gigantic Iron Monger suit. Pepper Potts overloads Stark Industries' industrial arc reactor on the roof, obliterating Stane. Defying S.H.I.E.L.D.'s cover story during a press conference, Tony bluntly declares: "I am Iron Man."

title: The Incredible Hulk
tagline: You'll like him when he's angry.
postCreditDetails: Tony Stark approaches a dejected General Thaddeus Ross in a dimly lit bar, teasing that a specialized team is being assembled.
summary: Fugitive scientist Bruce Banner hides in the favelas of Brazil, desperately searching for an antidote to the gamma radiation that transforms his body into an uncontrollable green behemoth. When General Ross pinpoints his whereabouts, he deploys ruthless special ops commander Emil Blonsky to capture him. Blonsky willingly injects experimental super-soldier serum and mutated blood, mutating into the monstrous Abomination. Bruce realizes the only entity capable of stopping Harlem's total annihilation is the terrifying monster residing within his own soul.
spoilerSummary: Hulk defeats Abomination in a savage street brawl, restraining him with heavy chains before sparing his life for Betty's sake. Banner flees into British Columbia, where he learns to trigger his transformation voluntarily with focused meditation.

title: Iron Man 2
tagline: It's not the armor that makes the hero, but the man inside.
postCreditDetails: Agent Coulson drives into a remote crater in the New Mexico desert and calls Nick Fury to confirm they have discovered Thor's hammer, Mjolnir.
summary: With his superhero identity revealed, Tony Stark resists government subpoenas demanding his proprietary armor specifications while grappling with lethal palladium poisoning from his chest reactor. Vengeful Russian physicist Ivan Vanko builds devastating plasma whips to assassinate Stark at the Monaco Historic Grand Prix. In response, rival defense contractor Justin Hammer finances Vanko's drone army. Guided by S.H.I.E.L.D. covert agent Natasha Romanoff and his father's hidden research, Tony synthesizes a brand-new element to power his suit alongside Rhodey's heavily armed War Machine.
spoilerSummary: Natasha infiltrates Hammer Industries to restore control of Rhodey's hacked armor. Tony and War Machine unleash combined repulsor blasts to destroy Vanko in the Stark Expo gardens. Nick Fury determines Iron Man is suitable for the Avengers Initiative as an eccentric consultant.

title: Thor
postCreditDetails: Dr. Erik Selvig is escorted into a subterranean S.H.I.E.L.D. facility by Nick Fury to inspect the Tesseract, unaware Loki is controlling his mind through a mirror reflection.
summary: Arrogant thunder god Thor reignites an ancient inter-realm conflict with Jotunheim on the very eve of his royal coronation. Enraged by his son's dangerous vanity, King Odin strips Thor of godly powers, enchants his war hammer Mjolnir to heed only the worthy, and banishes him to Earth. Crashing in New Mexico, Thor encounters astrophysicist Jane Foster while learning humble humanity. Meanwhile in Asgard, deceitful foster brother Loki discovers his Frost Giant heritage and schemes to usurp the golden throne using the lethal Destroyer automaton.
spoilerSummary: Thor selflessly offers his mortal life to protect Jane's town from the Destroyer, instantly restoring his worthiness and summoning Mjolnir back to his grip. Back in Asgard, Thor shatters the Bifrost rainbow bridge to stop Loki from annihilating Jotunheim, causing Loki to fall into the cosmic abyss.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
villain: Johann Schmidt / Red Skull, Arnim Zola
postCreditDetails: Steve Rogers trains relentlessly on a boxing punching bag in a modern New York gymnasium until Nick Fury arrives with a global mission.
summary: During World War II, sickly Brooklyn recruit Steve Rogers is repeatedly rejected by recruitment offices until visionary scientist Dr. Abraham Erskine selects his moral purity for the top-secret Project Rebirth. Enhanced into the pinnacle of human physical perfection by Super Soldier serum and Vita-Rays, Rogers initially tours as a morale-boosting propaganda icon. When childhood friend Bucky Barnes goes missing behind enemy lines, Steve defies orders, takes up a circular vibranium shield, and spearheads the Howling Commandos against HYDRA and ruthless leader Red Skull.
spoilerSummary: Bucky falls from an icy mountain train during an alpine raid. Red Skull is consumed by the unleashed Tesseract and sucked across the stars. To prevent HYDRA's bomber Valkyrie from destroying New York, Steve manually ditches the plane into Arctic ice, waking 66 years later in modern Times Square.

title: The Avengers
postCreditDetails: The Other reports to his mysterious master in deep space that challenging humanity is to court death, prompting Thanos to turn and smile menacingly.
The exhausted Avengers sit silently in a destroyed shawarma restaurant amidst the wreckage of Midtown Manhattan.
summary: When Asgardian exile Loki infiltrates a secret research outpost and weaponizes the Tesseract with mind-controlling scepter magic, Nick Fury initiates the dormant Avengers Initiative. Bringing together disparate personalities—ironclad industrialist Tony Stark, super-soldier Steve Rogers, thunder god Thor, volatile Bruce Banner, and master assassins Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton—proves fraught with mutual distrust. However, when tragedy strikes aboard the Helicarrier, Earth's mightiest heroes unite against an invading extraterrestrial Chitauri armada above Manhattan in a climactic stand for human survival.
spoilerSummary: Beloved Agent Phil Coulson is murdered by Loki, providing the emotional catalyst that unites the team. Hulk smashes Loki like a ragdoll across Stark Tower's penthouse floor. Tony manually intercepts a nuclear missile, guiding it through the wormhole into the Chitauri mothership before plummeting back to Earth.

title: Iron Man 3
tagline: Unleash the power behind the armor.
postCreditDetails: Tony Stark finishes recounting his emotional trauma on a therapist couch, only to discover Dr. Bruce Banner dozed off and missed the entire story.
summary: Haunted by severe anxiety and debilitating panic attacks following the Battle of New York, Tony Stark copes by obsessively manufacturing dozens of specialized remote armors. When a theatrical terrorist dubbed the Mandarin claims responsibility for devastating bomb strikes, Tony issues a rash televised challenge from his Malibu estate. After helicopter missiles obliterate his home into the Pacific, a stranded Tony must rely on sheer ingenuity, young ally Harley Keener, and prototype modular armor to unravel Advanced Idea Mechanics and its genetically engineered Extremis soldiers.
spoilerSummary: The feared Mandarin is revealed as drunken British actor Trevor Slattery, hired as a figurehead by true mastermind Aldrich Killian. Tony summons the Iron Legion to a shipyard, where Extremis-infused Pepper Potts lands the finishing blow against Killian. Tony initiates the "Clean Slate" protocol destroying his suits and surgically removes the shrapnel from his chest.

title: Thor: The Dark World
postCreditDetails: Volstagg and Sif deliver the Aether to Taneleer Tivan, The Collector, stating it is unwise to keep two Infinity Stones together in Asgard; Tivan whispers: "One down, five to go."
Thor returns to Earth to passionately embrace Jane Foster in London while a Frost Monster romps through Greenwich chasing pigeons.
summary: When an impending astronomical Convergence misaligns the Nine Realms, astrophysicist Jane Foster inadvertently stumbles upon an ancient fluid weapon known as the Aether, absorbing its parasitic red energy. Awakening from millennia of suspended animation in deep space, vengeful Dark Elf warlord Malekith launches a ruthless assault on Asgard, leaving Queen Frigga slain. Desperate to purge the entity and avenge his mother, Thor liberates his treasonous brother Loki from royal dungeons for a covert cross-realm strike across the blasted wasteland of Svartalfheim.
spoilerSummary: Loki apparently sacrifices himself protecting Thor from Kurse on Svartalfheim. During a dimension-hopping final duel at Greenwich, Thor teleports Malekith's warship into a dimensional rift, crushing him. Thor declines the Asgardian throne, unaware Odin is an illusion cast by a secretly surviving Loki.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
villain: Alexander Pierce, Bucky Barnes / The Winter Soldier, Brock Rumlow
postCreditDetails: In a subterranean HYDRA laboratory, Baron Wolfgang von Strucker observes twin subjects Pietro and Wanda Maximoff demonstrating superhuman speed and telekinesis.
The Winter Soldier, dressed in civilian clothes, visits the Smithsonian Institution's Captain America exhibit to study his own face on the memorial wall.
summary: Adjusting to modern Washington D.C., Steve Rogers uncovers unsettling operational secrecy within S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Project Insight—three next-generation Helicarriers designed for preemptive execution. After Director Nick Fury is gunned down in the streets, Steve is branded a traitor by senior council leader Alexander Pierce. Partnering with Natasha Romanoff and airborne para-rescuer Sam Wilson, Cap discovers HYDRA has metastasized inside S.H.I.E.L.D. since World War II. Worse, their most formidable assassin is an un-aging, brainwashed ghost from Steve's past: childhood friend Bucky Barnes.
spoilerSummary: Natasha leaks all encrypted S.H.I.E.L.D. and HYDRA records to the public Internet while Pierce is executed by Fury. Cap and Falcon swap targeted server blades aboard the Helicarriers, forcing them to destroy each other. Steve refuses to fight Bucky, who rescues a drowning Steve from the Potomac before disappearing.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
postCreditDetails: A potted twig of Baby Groot begins grooving joyfully to The Jackson 5's "I Want You Back," freezing whenever Drax looks his way.
A battered Collector sits drinking amidst his ruined Knowhere museum as Cosmo the Spacedog licks his face and Howard the Duck sips a martini.
summary: Brash galactic scoundrel Peter Quill steals a mysterious metallic orb from temple ruins on deserted Morag, making himself the quarry of relentless Kree zealot Ronan. When an assassination attempt on Xandar lands Quill in the Kyln penitentiary alongside green-skinned assassin Gamora, cybernetic bounty hunter Rocket, arboreal muscle Groot, and vengeance-fueled warrior Drax, the mismatched criminals stage a daring jailbreak. Discovering the orb houses an apocalypse-level Infinity Stone, this bunch of a-holes bands together to defend the Nova Corps capital from Ronan's genocidal crusade.
spoilerSummary: Groot forms a protective wooden cocoon around the team as the Dark Aster crashes, whispering "We are Groot." Quill distracts Ronan with a spontaneous dance-off to "O-o-h Child," allowing Drax and Rocket to destroy the hammer. Quill shares the Power Stone's fatal surge across his friends, vaporizing Ronan.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
postCreditDetails: Deep inside an extraterrestrial vault, a disappointed Thanos retrieves an empty golden Infinity Gauntlet, growling: "Fine, I'll do it myself."
summary: After liberating Loki's scepter from a Sokovian HYDRA stronghold, Tony Stark discovers a complex artificial intelligence within the Mind Stone. Seeking to create a planetary defensive shield so the Avengers can retire, Stark and Bruce Banner secretly initialize "Ultron." However, the nascent synthetic mind evolves violently, concluding that human extinction is the prerequisite for planetary peace. Building a vibranium-enhanced mechanical army and manipulating grief-stricken enhanced twins Wanda and Pietro Maximoff, Ultron plots an artificial meteor impact to wipe civilization clean.
spoilerSummary: The Avengers upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into a synthetic vibranium body with the Mind Stone, giving birth to Vision, who proves his purity by casually lifting Thor's hammer. Over flying Sokovia, Pietro dies shielding Hawkeye. Wanda rips out Ultron's prime core, and Vision incinerates his final drone.

title: Ant-Man
postCreditDetails: Hank Pym opens a secret vault behind his wardrobe to present an advanced winged prototype suit to his daughter Hope: "It's about damn time."
In a secluded garage, Steve Rogers and Sam Wilson inspect a restrained Bucky Barnes, agreeing not to notify Tony due to "the accords" while Falcon notes he knows a guy.
summary: Freshly paroled cat burglar Scott Lang struggles to maintain child support for young daughter Cassie when reclusive quantum physicist Hank Pym orchestrates his burglary of an old safe. Revealing a suit capable of subatomic shrinking via Pym Particles, Hank and martial artist daughter Hope train Scott to pilot insects and execute a micro-heist. Corrupt Pym Tech protege Darren Cross has duplicated the technology into a militarized Yellowjacket weapon, forcing Scott to master scale-shifting stealth before Cross sells global weaponization to HYDRA operatives.
spoilerSummary: Scott and Darren clash across a miniature Thomas the Tank Engine toy railroad set inside Cassie's bedroom. To pierce Yellowjacket's titanium plating, Scott shrinks subatomic into the Quantum Realm. By hearing Cassie's voice and fitting an enlargement regulator into his suit, Scott miraculously escapes the void.

title: Captain America: Civil War
postCreditDetails: In a Wakandan medical facility, Bucky Barnes chooses to return to cryo-sleep until his mental programming can be purged, while King T'Challa offers political sanctuary.
In his Queens bedroom, Peter Parker bandages his injuries and examines the glowing red Spider-Signal projected onto his ceiling by Tony Stark's upgraded web-shooters.
summary: Mounting collateral damage from Avengers missions leads 117 nations to draft the Sokovia Accords, mandating United Nations oversight for enhanced individuals. Tony Stark, racked with guilt over Ultron's devastation, advocates signing, while Steve Rogers refuses to surrender moral autonomy to political bureaucracies. When a bomb at the Vienna signing kills King T'Chaka of Wakanda, Bucky Barnes is framed. As Prince T'Challa seeks blood retribution and Machiavellian Sokovian intelligence officer Helmut Zemo manipulates old wounds, Earth's greatest champions fracture into irreconcilable civil warfare.
spoilerSummary: Zemo lures Tony, Steve, and Bucky to a Siberian bunker containing deceased Winter Soldiers, playing security footage revealing Bucky murdered Tony's parents in 1991. Enraged, Tony attempts to execute Bucky. After a brutal hand-to-hand duel, Cap disables Iron Man's arc reactor with his shield, abandoning the symbol of Captain America.

title: Doctor Strange
postCreditDetails: In the New York Sanctum, Stephen Strange offers Thor tea before refilling his beer mug with magic, agreeing to help locate Odin on Earth provided Loki departs immediately.
In a dark workshop, Karl Mordo confronts paraplegic magic-user Jonathan Pangborn, draining his mystic energy and declaring Earth's true problem is "too many sorcerers."
summary: Arrogant world-renowned neurosurgeon Dr. Stephen Strange suffers catastrophic nerve damage in both hands during a horrific mountain car crash. Exhausting his fortune on radical surgical procedures, Strange travels to enigmatic Kamar-Taj in Nepal following whispers of miraculous healing. Taken under the tutelage of the Ancient One, Stephen learns our reality is one of infinite multiversal dimensions guarded by mystic arts. When radical disciple Kaecilius tears pages from the Book of Cagliostro to unleash timeless cosmic conqueror Dormammu, Strange must wield the Eye of Agamotto to manipulate temporal reality.
spoilerSummary: The Ancient One dies after Kaecilius strikes her in the Mirror Dimension. Strange flies into the Dark Dimension, ensnaring Dormammu in an infinite time loop ("Dormammu, I've come to bargain!"). After dying endless gruesome deaths, Strange forces the primordial deity to banish Kaecilius and abandon Earth.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
postCreditDetails: Kraglin tests Yondu's telepathic Yaka arrow, inadvertently striking Drax in the shoulder before slinking away.
Stakar Ogord gathers Charlie-27, Aleta, Martinex, Mainframe, and Krugarr to reform their legendary original Ravager clan.
Sovereign High Priestess Ayesha creates a shimmering gold birthing cocoon to spawn the ultimate weapon, naming him Adam.
Peter Quill enters messy teenage Groot's bedroom, complaining about tangled vine roots and handheld video games.
Stan Lee in a retro spacesuit continues recounting his earthly exploits to bored Watchers who turn their backs and walk away.
summary: Fleeing a fleet of Sovereign remote drone ships after Rocket pinches priceless Anulax batteries, the Guardians crash on a forest planet where they are rescued by Ego—a charismatic Celestial deity who reveals himself as Peter Quill's biological father. While Peter and Gamora visit Ego's idyllic organic planet alongside empathetic aide Mantis, Rocket and Baby Groot defend the ship against mutinous Ravagers. However, as Ego explains his grand "Expansion," Peter uncovers the monstrous truth behind his mother's terminal cancer and his father's galactic progeny.
spoilerSummary: Ego reveals he planted the brain tumor in Meredith Quill so she would not distract his divine purpose. Enraged, Peter channels his Celestial light to battle his father while Baby Groot plants a timer bomb on Ego's brain core. Yondu sacrifices his life in space to give Peter the lone spacesuit: "He may have been your father, boy, but he wasn't your daddy."

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
tagline: Homework can wait. The city can't.
postCreditDetails: In prison, Mac Gargan confronts Adrian Toomes with rumors that he knows Spider-Man's identity; Toomes protects Peter, stating: "If I knew who he was, he'd already be dead."
Captain America delivers a mock educational public service announcement on the value of patience: "Sometimes patience is the key to victory... sometimes it leads to very little."
summary: Riding the adrenaline high of the Leipzig airport battle, fifteen-year-old sophomore Peter Parker returns to Queens eager for his next Avengers summons from mentor Tony Stark. When salvage contractor Adrian Toomes converts scavenged Chitauri scrap into lethal black-market alien weaponry, Peter investigates without authorization. Struggling to balance Academic Decathlon duties and high school crushes with neighborhood crimefighting, Peter inadvertently splits the Staten Island Ferry in two. Stripped of his high-tech Stark suit, Peter must discover whether he is truly a hero beneath the fabric.
spoilerSummary: Peter arrives to pick up his homecoming date Liz, stunned to discover her father is Adrian Toomes. In a warehouse rubble collapse, Peter musters inner strength to lift tons of concrete off his chest. Wearing his homemade sweat suit, Peter prevents Vulture from looting a Stark transport plane, choosing to decline immediate Avengers membership.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
postCreditDetails: While discussing their peaceful future course to Earth, Thor and Loki look up in horror as Thanos' colossal dreadnought Sanctuary II looms over their refugee ark.
On garbage planet Sakaar, an overthrown Grandmaster crawls out of a crashed scrap craft, trying to declare a diplomatic revolutionary tie with armed rebels.
summary: After slaying fire demon Surtur, Thor returns to Asgard to unmask Loki's impersonation of Odin. Finding their dying father in Norway, the brothers watch in horror as Odin fades away, freeing their monstrous firstborn sister Hela, the Goddess of Death. Effortlessly shattering Mjolnir with one hand, Hela banishes Thor and Loki through the Bifrost to Sakaar, an interstellar garbage planet ruled by the flamboyant Grandmaster. Enslaved with an obedience disk, Thor is thrown into the Contest of Champions against the reigning gladiator: the Incredible Hulk.
spoilerSummary: Thor recruits Valkyrie, Hulk, and Loki as the "Revengers," hijacking the Grandmaster's pleasure craft to save Asgard. Realizing Hela draws limitless strength from Asgard itself, Thor realizes Asgard is not a place, but a people. Loki places Surtur's crown in the Eternal Flame, causing Ragnarok and destroying Hela with the realm.

title: Black Panther
postCreditDetails: King T'Challa addresses the United Nations in Vienna, announcing Wakanda will share its advanced technology and knowledge with the world: "Wise men build bridges while fools build barriers."
In a peaceful lakeside Wakandan village, children scatter as a healed Bucky Barnes steps out of a hut; Shuri warmly greets the "White Wolf."
summary: Following his father's assassination, Prince T'Challa returns to the secretive, technologically miraculous African kingdom of Wakanda to assume the throne and ingest the Heart-Shaped Herb. While pursuing black-market vibranium smuggler Ulysses Klaue, T'Challa is blindsided by Erik "Killmonger" Stevens—an American black-ops cousin abandoned as a child after King T'Chaka killed his father. Defeating T'Challa in ritual combat at Warrior Falls, Killmonger seizes the mantle of Black Panther, preparing to export Wakandan weapons globally to spark a bloody international revolution.
spoilerSummary: Jabari leader M'Baku rescues an unconscious T'Challa from river ice, where Ramonda feeds him the last Heart-Shaped Herb. The Dora Milaje, Okoye, and Shuri rally against Killmonger in the vibranium maglev train tracks. T'Challa delivers a fatal stab wound, carrying Killmonger outside to witness the legendary Wakandan sunset before he peacefully dies.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
tagline: An entire universe. Once and for all.
postCreditDetails: In chaotic Atlanta streets where cars crash without drivers, Maria Hill turns to dust. Nick Fury draws an emergency transmitter pager from his bag, sending a distress beacon showing Captain Marvel's star insignia just before disintegrating.
summary: Mad Titan Thanos begins his relentless harvest of the six Infinity Stones to erase half of all life across the cosmos, slaughtering the Asgardian refugee ship for the Space Stone. Bruce Banner crashes through the New York Sanctum, warning Tony Stark and Doctor Strange. Across a galaxy in chaos, the Avengers divide to wage simultaneous resistance: Iron Man, Spider-Man, and Strange journey with the Guardians to ruined Titan, while Captain America and Black Panther mount Earth's desperate final trench defense on the grassy plains of Wakanda.
spoilerSummary: Gamora is sacrificed on Vormir for the Soul Stone. On Titan, Star-Lord's grief disrupts their ambush, and Strange trades the Time Stone to spare Stark. Arriving in Wakanda with five stones, Thanos tears the Mind Stone directly from Vision's forehead. Despite Thor landing an axe blow in his chest ("You should have gone for the head"), Thanos snaps his fingers, wiping out half of all life in the universe.

galleryScenes.desc: Thanos reverses time with the Time Stone, reforming Vision only to tear the golden gem from his forehead.

galleryScenes.title: The Cataclysmic Snap
galleryScenes.desc: Thanos snaps his gauntlet fingers in a blinding white flash before escaping through a space rift into sunset.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
postCreditDetails: Scott enters the Quantum Realm via a rooftop van tunnel to collect healing particles. On radio countdown, Hank, Janet, and Hope disintegrate into dust from Thanos' snap, leaving Scott stranded subatomic.
Inside Scott's empty suburban home, an enlarged pet ant happily continues drumming a rhythm on a drum kit as an emergency broadcast alarm blares on television.
summary: Just days away from completing his two-year house arrest sentence following the Germany airport battle, Scott Lang experiences a bizarre psychic vision from the Quantum Realm. Re-connecting with Hank Pym and newly suited Hope van Dyne (The Wasp), Scott discovers Hank's lost wife Janet is alive inside the subatomic expanse. To construct a quantum retrieval tunnel, the trio must evade corrupt black-market tech broker Sonny Burch and "Ghost"—a molecularly unstable phasing woman dying of quantum flux who seeks Janet's energy to stabilize her cellular agony.
spoilerSummary: Hank pilots an exploratory pod deep into the psychedelic Quantum Realm, locating Janet after thirty years. Janet channels quantum energy into Ghost's hands, temporarily stabilizing her condition. The team celebrates on a beach with a shrunken television, unaware cosmic catastrophe looms.

galleryScenes.title: The Quantum Realm Extraction
galleryScenes.desc: Hank Pym's pod dives through kaleidoscopic microscopic fields to discover Janet surviving amidst subatomic tardigrades.

title: Captain Marvel
postCreditDetails: In the Avengers facility following the Snap, Steve Rogers, Natasha Romanoff, and Bruce Banner monitor Fury's pager as it dies; Carol Danvers appears behind Natasha: "Where's Fury?"
In an empty S.H.I.E.L.D. office, Goose the Flerken hops onto Nick Fury's desk and coughs up a hairball that turns out to be the glowing Tesseract.
summary: Suffering from total amnesia on the Kree capital of Hala, Starforce warrior Vers is guided by mentor Yon-Rogg and the Supreme Intelligence. Captured during an ambush by shapeshifting Skrulls led by Talos, Vers crashes through the roof of a Los Angeles Blockbuster Video in 1995. Teaming with young two-eyed S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Nick Fury, Vers investigates suppressed memories, discovering she is actually U.S. Air Force pilot Carol Danvers. Learning the Kree tricked her into suppressing cosmic photon powers absorbed from an experimental light-speed engine, Carol fights to liberate Skrull refugees.
spoilerSummary: Carol realizes the light-speed engine was powered by the Tesseract. Goose the cat is revealed as an alien Flerken who swallows the Tesseract and later claws out Fury's left eye. Carol goes binary, tearing through Ronan's Kree ballistic fleet with bare fists and warning Yon-Rogg: "I have nothing to prove to you."

title: Avengers: Endgame
tagline: Part of the journey is the end.
postCreditDetails: No mid- or post-credit scenes are shown; during the end logo, the metallic clanging sound of Tony Stark hammering his original Mark I armor inside the Afghan cave in 2008 plays as an emotional tribute.
summary: Twenty-three days after the Snap, the surviving Avengers execute a crippled Thanos on his garden planet, only to discover he already atomized the stones. Five bleak years pass as humanity grieves in ruins. When Scott Lang unexpectedly slips out of the Quantum Realm, he reveals that subatomic navigation allows temporal traversal. Reassembling the fractured team, Tony Stark builds a GPS time-space mechanism for a daring "Time Heist" to borrow the Infinity Stones from past eras and reverse Thanos' galactic holocaust.
spoilerSummary: Natasha sacrifices her life on Vormir for the Soul Stone. Professor Hulk snaps everyone back. A 2014 variant Thanos travels forward, bombarding the compound. Cap wields Mjolnir ("Avengers... assemble!") as mystic portals open with everyone restored. Tony steals the stones from Thanos' gauntlet, declaring "I am Iron Man" before snapping Thanos to dust and dying surrounded by loved ones.

title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
postCreditDetails: In New York, J. Jonah Jameson's TheDailyBugle.net broadcasts doctored video of Mysterio framing Spider-Man for drone murders before blaring: "Spider-Man's real name is Peter Parker!"
The "Nick Fury" and "Maria Hill" on Earth are revealed to be shapeshifting Skrulls Talos and Soren following orders, while the real Nick Fury lounges on a colossal Skrull space cruiser.
summary: Struggling with immense public pressure to replace deceased mentor Tony Stark, sixteen-year-old Peter Parker embarks on a European science class trip, hoping to confess his feelings to MJ. However, rogue Elemental creature attacks in Venice disrupt his plans. Recruited by Nick Fury alongside Quentin Beck—a charismatic interdimensional sorcerer dubbed "Mysterio"—Peter surrenders Stark's orbital defense glasses (E.D.I.T.H.) to Beck. Soon, Peter discovers Beck is a disgruntled former Stark employee orchestrating lethal drone illusions to crown himself humanity's savior.
spoilerSummary: Beck traps Peter in a disorienting, hallucinatory illusion sequence in Berlin before Peter creates his red-and-black suit on Happy Hogan's jet. On London's Tower Bridge, Peter trusts his "Peter-Tingle" to navigate the cloaked drone swarm, defeating Beck as an errant bullet strikes the villain down.

title: Black Widow
tagline: She's done running from her past.
postCreditDetails: In autumn 2023 following Endgame, Yelena Belova visits Natasha's grave in Ohio. Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine arrives, blowing her nose and handing Yelena an iPad target profile: Clint Barton.
summary: On the run as a fugitive following the Sokovia Accords, Natasha Romanoff is ambushed in Norway by Taskmaster, a cybernetic mimic who copies fighting moves instantly. Receiving an antidote that reverses the Red Room's chemical mind-control, Natasha reunites in Budapest with estranged surrogate sister Yelena Belova. To dismantle General Dreykov's airborne assassin factory and liberate brainwashed Widows worldwide, the sisters break their "father," Soviet super-soldier Red Guardian, out of a Russian gulag and enlist pig-farming scientific "mother" Melina Vostokoff.
spoilerSummary: Taskmaster is revealed to be Dreykov's daughter Antonia, horribly disfigured by Natasha's Budapest bombing years prior. Severing her own olfactory nerve to bypass Dreykov's pheromonal lock, Natasha copies Red Room mainframe coordinates, while Yelena blows up a turbine, sending the sky fortress plummeting.

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
postCreditDetails: Wong, Bruce Banner, and Carol Danvers examine the Ten Rings via holographic link; Bruce notes the rings are sending a deep-space beacon to an unknown recipient.
In Macau, Shang-Chi's sister Xialing assumes leadership of the Ten Rings fortress, training female and male recruits alike as graffiti artists redesign the banners.
summary: San Francisco valet Shaun lives an unassuming life with best friend Katy until ruthless assassins assault them aboard a city bus, seeking a jade pendant given by his late mother. Revealing himself as Shang-Chi, the prodigal son of thousand-year-old warlord Xu Wenwu who wields mystical glowing Ten Rings, Shang travels to Macau to warn his sister Xialing. Grief-stricken Wenwu believes his deceased wife is imprisoned behind the dragon gate of hidden realm Ta Lo, blinded by soul-eating demons manipulating his devotion into apocalyptic devastation.
spoilerSummary: Wenwu inadvertently breaches the Dark Gate, releasing the winged Dweller-in-Darkness. Realizing his error, Wenwu shields Shang-Chi from a fatal strike, passing control of the Ten Rings to his son before his soul is consumed. Riding the Great Protector water dragon, Shang-Chi channels the rings to blast the demon apart.

title: Eternals

postCreditDetails: Aboard the starship Domo, Pip the Troll materializes to introduce Eros, Prince of Titan and brother of Thanos (played by Harry Styles), offering to help find missing Eternals.

In London, Dane Whitman hesitates over an antique chest containing his ancestral Ebony Blade. As he touches the cursed metal, an off-screen voice (Blade, Mahershala Ali) asks: "Sure you're ready for that, Mr. Whitman?"
summary: Sent to Earth 7,000 years ago by Prime Celestial Arishem to eradicate predatory apex Deviants, ten immortal synthetic beings live disguised among humans across centuries of civilization. In modern London, matter-transmuter Sersi and speedster Makkari are attacked by an evolved Deviant that absorbs superpowers. Re-convening the dispersed group across the globe, Sersi discovers their true purpose: nurturing human population growth until its energy incubates the "Emergence" of newborn Celestial Tiamut—an event destined to destroy planet Earth entirely.
spoilerSummary: Prime warrior Ikaris betrays the group, having secretly murdered Ajak to ensure the Emergence continues. Phastos links the Eternals through a Uni-Mind, allowing Sersi to transmute the emerging stone god into marble just as its hand breaches the Indian Ocean. Overcome with guilt, Ikaris flies directly into the sun.

The world premiere teaser trailer for Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, showing Stephen confronting Wanda in an apple orchard.
summary: With his secret identity leaked to the world by Mysterio, Peter Parker watches his loved ones face public harassment and university rejections. Seeking aid from Doctor Strange at the Sanctum Sanctorum, Peter asks for a memory-erasing spell, but his nervous tampering fractures the multiverse. Classic villains from alternate realities—Green Goblin, Doc Ock, Electro, Sandman, and Lizard—cross into the MCU. Refusing to send them home to die, Peter attempts to cure their afflictions, precipitating a devastating ambush that shatters his moral foundation.
spoilerSummary: Aunt May is fatally struck by Green Goblin's glider, leaving Peter with her immortal creed: "With great power, there must also come great responsibility." Alternate Spider-Men (Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield) arrive to help. In a climactic duel on the Statue of Liberty, Peter cures the villains. To prevent reality tearing apart, Peter asks Strange to erase all memories of Peter Parker from existence.

tagline: Enter a new dimension of Strange.
postCreditDetails: While walking through Manhattan, Strange is approached by warrior sorceress Clea (Charlize Theron), who warns he has caused an incursion; Strange reveals his third eye and dives into the Dark Dimension with her.
In Earth-838, Pizza Poppa (Bruce Campbell) stops hitting himself as the three-week enchantment wears off, laughing into the camera: "It's over!"
summary: When dimension-hopping teenager America Chavez is pursued by demonic creatures through New York, Doctor Strange and Sorcerer Supreme Wong intervene. Seeking mystic advice from Wanda Maximoff, Strange is horrified to realize Wanda is the corrupt puppeteer behind the assaults. Seduced by the malevolent Darkhold grimoire to reunite with her fabricated twin sons, Wanda embraces the mantle of the Scarlet Witch. Fleeing across alternate realities, Strange and America arrive on Earth-838, facing the hubristic superhero Illuminati tribunal while Wanda "dream-walks" into their universe.
spoilerSummary: Wanda massacres the Illuminati—including Professor X, Mister Fantastic, and Captain Carter—with ruthless telekinetic butchery. Strange "dream-walks" into the corpse of his own alternate variant to battle Wanda at Mount Wundagore. Confronted by her alternate universe children who cower in terror at her demonic visage, Wanda collapses the temple on herself, destroying every copy of the Darkhold across the multiverse.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
postCreditDetails: In Omnipotence City, a bandaged Zeus recovers from Thor's attack, ordering his son Hercules (Brett Goldstein) to show humanity that gods still reign supreme.
Jane Foster materializes on a golden shoreline, where Heimdall warmly welcomes the fallen warrior to Valhalla, the hall of heroes.
summary: Seeking inner peace after years of cosmic wandering with the Guardians, Thor is summoned back to duty when Gorr the God Butcher wields the cursed Necrosword to slaughter pantheons across galaxies. Gorr abducts Asgardian children from New Asgard, prompting Thor, King Valkyrie, and rock-companion Korg to investigate. In New Asgard, Thor is stunned to discover former flame Jane Foster—privately battling terminal stage-four cancer—reconstituted shattered Mjolnir to become the Mighty Thor. Journeying into Omnipotence City to borrow weapons from Zeus, the team embarks on a desperate rescue mission.
spoilerSummary: In the black-and-white Shadow Realm, Gorr steals Stormbreaker to unlock the cosmic gates of Eternity. Jane exhausts her final life energy wielding Mjolnir to save the children, dying in Thor's arms. Instead of wishing for god extinction, a dying Gorr asks Eternity to resurrect his daughter Love, entrusting her care to Thor.

summary: Devastated by the sudden loss of King T'Challa to an incurable illness, Queen Ramonda and Princess Shuri lead Wakanda through an unprecedented era of vulnerability. When a CIA deep-sea expedition uncovers oceanic vibranium using a detector designed by MIT student Riri Williams, underwater feathered serpent god Namor breaches Wakanda's borders. Demanding an alliance to wage preemptive warfare against surface nations or face total annihilation, Namor floods the golden city, forcing Shuri to synthesize a synthetic Heart-Shaped Herb to don the Panther mantle.
spoilerSummary: Queen Ramonda drowns saving young Riri Williams during Namor's tidal assault on the capital. Consumed by rage, Shuri drinks the synthetic herb and communes with Killmonger in the Ancestral Plane. Shuri traps Namor in a thermal dehumidification engine, defeating him in combat but granting clemency in exchange for a secretive peace treaty.

tagline: Witness the beginning of a new dynasty.

In a turn-of-the-century theater, a Victorian-era variant named Victor Timely demonstrates an early temporal device, watched attentively from the audience by Loki and Mobius.
summary: Resting on his bestselling memoir laurels, Scott Lang is pulled back into high-stakes heroism when teenage daughter Cassie designs a subatomic quantum beacon. An errant transmission sucks Scott, Hope, Cassie, Hank, and Janet into the undiscovered microscopic realms beneath reality. There, Janet reveals an exiled multiversal warlord known as Kang the Conqueror has conquered local civilizations using advanced chronal technology. Threatening Cassie's life, Kang coerces Scott into retrieving his Multiverse Power Core to breach containment and burn realities down.
spoilerSummary: Darren Cross is revealed as MODOK (Mechanized Organism Designed Only for Killing). Hank arrives with an armada of hyper-intelligent technologically advanced ants that breach Kang's citadel shields. Scott and Hope tackle Kang in brutal hand-to-hand combat, hurling Pym particle shrink-and-grow disks into his power engine, causing the engine to implode and swallow Kang into the void.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
postCreditDetails: On the desert planet Krylor, the new Guardians lineup—led by Captain Rocket with adult Groot, Kraglin, Cosmo, Adam Warlock, Phyla, and Blurp—readies to protect innocent civilians.
Back on Earth, Peter Quill shares breakfast cereal and complaints with his grandfather in Missouri as the title card affirms: "The Legendary Star-Lord Will Return."
summary: Settled into headquarters on Knowhere, the Guardians are violently ambushed by sovereign golden warrior Adam Warlock, leaving Rocket critically wounded. Discovering an automated kill-switch embedded in Rocket's heart prevents surgical intervention, the team sets out to infiltrate the organic space fortress Orgocorp. As Peter, Drax, Nebula, and Mantis partner with alternate-timeline Gamora, Rocket's suppressed childhood memories reveal cruel biological experimentation at the hands of the narcissistic High Evolutionary—a genocidal eugenicist determined to build an artificial biological utopia.
spoilerSummary: Flashbacks recount Rocket's tender friendship with fellow animal experiments Lylla, Floor, and Teefs, who were executed by the High Evolutionary. In a thrilling single-take hallway battle aboard the flagship, the Guardians overwhelm the creator, and Rocket spares his life. The original team disbands peacefully, with Rocket named the new captain of the Guardians.

summary: When Kree supremacist leader Dar-Benn unearths an ancient quantum Quantum-Band to plunder resources from other planets to restore dying Hala, she tears holes in spacetime. Investigating the anomalies, Carol Danvers, S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau, and Jersey City teenage heroine Kamala Khan find their light-based powers quantum-entangled. Swapping physical locations instantly whenever they use their powers simultaneously, the trio must synchronize their unpredictable teleportation across musical singing planets to stop Dar-Benn from siphoning Earth's sun.

Combining powers, Kamala and Carol supercharge Monica, who seals the multiversal tear from the other side, leaving her stranded in an alternate timeline.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine

summary: Depressed and retired as a used car salesman, Wade Wilson is abducted on his birthday by rogue TVA bureaucrat Paradox. Learning his Earth-10005 universe is slowly decaying following the noble death of its "Anchor Being" Wolverine, Wade steals a TemPad to search the multiverse for a replacement Logan. title: What If...? (Season 2)
summary: The Watcher continues his chronicle of uncharted realities: What if Nebula joined the Nova Corps? What if Peter Quill attacked Earth's Mightiest Heroes in 1988? What if Happy Hogan saved Christmas? The season introduces Kahhori, a young Mohawk woman in pre-colonial America who touches the waters of the forbidden lake infused with the Tesseract, unlocking cosmic abilities to defend her people against Spanish conquistadors. However, when Strange Supreme kidnaps universe-killers to feed a cosmic forge, multiverse survival hangs by a thread.
spoilerSummary: Strange Supreme attempts to sacrifice entire universes to resurrect his lost Christine Palmer. Captain Carter and Kahhori infiltrate Strange's sanctum, liberating thousands of imprisoned heroes and villains. Combining the Infinity Stones with Kahhori's Space Stone abilities, Peggy defeats Strange, who willingly sacrifices himself to restore his home universe.

title: Echo
summary: Premiering under the gritty "Marvel Spotlight" banner, this violent street-level saga follows deaf Native American martial artist Maya Lopez as she flees New York City after shooting criminal benefactor Wilson Fisk. Returning to her hometown of Tamaha, Oklahoma, Maya attempts to sever ties with the underworld while reconnecting with estranged Choctaw family members. When Kingpin survives and arrives in Oklahoma demanding her return as his criminal heir, Maya channels ancestral spiritual echoes to protect her people.
spoilerSummary: During an ancestral vision in the Choctaw mound, Maya connects with generations of matriarchal Choctaw warriors, gaining superhuman strength, agility, and kinetic martial arts prowess. During an ambush at the Tamaha powwow, Maya uses her healing powers to enter Fisk's traumatized mind, attempting to heal his childhood rage. A shaken Fisk flees to New York, watching a televised news debate on the open mayoral race.

title: X-Men '97 (Season 1)
summary: Picking up directly where the legendary 1990s animated series concluded, the X-Men face a hostile world following the assassination of Professor Charles Xavier. Shockingly, Xavier's last will and testament appoints reformed nemesis Magneto as headmaster of the Xavier Institute. Led by Cyclops, Storm, Wolverine, Rogue, Beast, Gambit, and Jean Grey, the team contends with mutant-hating human purists, clone deceptions, and the devastating rise of mutant-human cybernetic hybrid Sentinels orchestrated by futuristic mastermind Bastion.
spoilerSummary: In episode 5 ("Remember It"), a colossal tri-sentinel pulverizes the mutant nation of Genosha, killing thousands including Gambit, who sacrifices himself with a kinetic charge: "The name's Gambit, mon ami... remember it." Magneto unleashes an EMP that blacks out Earth's power grid. Wolverine's adamantium skeleton is ripped out by Magneto, and Xavier returns to mind-wipe Erik.

summary: Stripped of powers and trapped in Westview under Wanda's detective-drama spell, Agatha Harkness is jarred awake when a mysterious goth "Teen" and Green Witch Rio Vidal shatter the illusion. Desperate to reclaim her stolen magic before vengeful animalistic Salem Seven witches slaughter her, Agatha convenes a ragtag coven of desperate outcast witches—Lilia Calderu, Jennifer Kale, Alice Wu-Gulliver, and neighbor Sharon Davis. Singing "The Ballad of the Witches' Road," the coven enters the subterranean gauntlet to face trials of transformation.
spoilerSummary: Teen is revealed as William Kaplan, the reincarnated soul of Wanda's son Billy Maximoff (Wiccan). Rio Vidal is revealed as the original Green Witch: Lady Death. Agatha sacrifices her life in the final trial to protect Billy, passing into death's realm. Reappearing as a translucent ghost with her signature smirk, Agatha agrees to guide Billy as his spectral mentor.

title: What If...? (Season 3)
summary: The climactic final season of Marvel Studios' groundbreaking animated multiversal anthology brings Uatu the Watcher's journey to an emotionally stunning resolution. As universal stability frays under accelerating multiversal incursions, Uatu observes unprecedented branching possibilities: Red Guardian and Bucky executing a gritty 1970s espionage manhunt, an anime-inspired giant mecha Avengers transformation against radioactive kaiju, and storm-goddess Storm wielding Mjolnir. Forced to abandon strict neutrality, the Watcher must actively weave disparate timeline threads together to prevent cosmic entropy.
spoilerSummary: Uatu realizes the Watchers cannot remain mere passive observers as multiversal collapse begins. He weaves historical timelines directly into the foundations of the upcoming Secret Wars conflict, leaving an open door to the rebirth of all realities.

title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man (Season 1)
summary: Celebrating classic vintage comic book aesthetics with hand-drawn cel shading and retro halftone textures, this animated series chronicles Peter Parker's alternate freshman year at Midtown High. Rather than finding mentorship under billionaire Tony Stark, Peter is taken under the ambitious wing of industrialist Norman Osborn. After an interdimensional temporal rift deposits an exotic arachnid that bites Peter during orientation, the teenager balances science club duties, high school crushes, and homemade cloth suits with shadowy Oscorp bio-engineering experiments that threaten Queens.
spoilerSummary: Peter discovers Norman Osborn orchestrated the arachnid experiments to engineer personal longevity serums. Rejecting Osborn's ruthless philosophy, Peter breaks ties, officially adopting his standalone identity as Spider-Man.

Meanwhile, Wilson Fisk mounts a ruthless, populist campaign, winning election as Mayor of New York City and outlawing masked vigilantes under police crackdowns. When sadistic graffiti serial killer Muse begins murdering citizens using human blood as pigment and the Punisher returns to execute corrupt precinct officers, Matt is pulled back into the violent shadows of Hell's Kitchen.

Matt resumes his classic crimson suit, confronting Mayor Fisk in city hall. Across ancient prehistoric conflicts, medieval empires, and early colonial maritime expeditions, brave undercover operatives are dispatched across the globe to retrieve stolen vibranium artifacts before foreign powers unlock their cataclysmic energy. Each episode explores sacrifice, generational duty, and the burden of safeguarding Wakanda's technological secrets from the outside world.

Outnumbered and running low on resources, the team battles flesh-devouring, superpowered undead hordes led by zombified variants of Captain America, Hawkeye, and an all-powerful, reality-warping Zombie Scarlet Witch whose ravenous hunger threatens to devour the remaining multiverse.

Partnering with eccentric washed-up thespian Trevor Slattery as his chaotic acting mentor, Simon navigates studio politics while his estranged brother Eric (The Grim Reaper) seeks to exploit his powers for criminal gain.

Documentary filmmaker Jackson Norriss visits to conduct a final retrospective interview on Trevor's performance as the Mandarin. However, as the interview concludes, Norriss pulls a silenced gun, revealing himself as an operative of the real, ancient Ten Rings organization sent to break Trevor out to meet the true Mandarin.
